These fixtures contain 499 real assay rows from all 29 ncRNA assays, with
released predictions for all 23 models. They cover the three RNA categories,
single and multiple mutations, repeated measurements, and EVmutation coverage.
Janzen fam1A.1, Guy tRNA and the NELF-E aptamer hold 32 EVmutation-covered
variants at each of two mutation counts, enough for the Depth macro. The
Domingo alignment contains 1,000 records from the released Riboseek MSA.
